title: Elevator Service Request Form
subtitle: Elevator Service: defines need, constraints, and assignment.
description: Elevator Service Request Form covers elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing. The building elevator coordinator records Elevator Service need, timing, access, and assignment. Elevator Service Request Form keeps Elevator Service exceptions visible until the building elevator coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Elevator Service Request Form at machine space, hoistway access point, car, and affected landings. Document elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing identity before Elevator Service begins. Compare elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing findings with stated Elevator Service criteria; route unresolved Elevator Service issues to licensed or otherwise qualified elevator service reviewer. For Elevator Service Request Form, confirm requirements for Elevator Service. Ask licensed or otherwise qualified elevator service reviewer to review Elevator Service conditions beyond the building elevator coordinator's role.

sections.title: Request context and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Elevator Service, identify responsible parties, machine space, hoistway access point, car, and affected landings, and the linked elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing source.

sections.guidance: Capture Elevator Service facts for elevator, controller, door system, communication device, and landing; include result, limit, source, and next control.

sections.title: Request constraints, assignment, and response
sections.guidance: Resolve open Elevator Service request questions; have building elevator coordinator record the assignment, response owner, and requester follow-up while keeping the record strictly at the intake and routing stage.

blocks.label: Scheduling constraints, holds, and supplied evidence
items: Work or testing beyond technician qualification
Prior or requester-supplied: unit and controller identification photographs
Prior or requester-supplied: fault history or controller indication
Prior or requester-supplied: test and measurement record within authorized scope
Prior or requester-supplied: out-of-service notice and restoration confirmation
blocks.guidance: Do not assign or authorize the Elevator Service request when the unit cannot be secured, a life-safety device fails, or required qualified elevator review is unavailable. Retain information supplied with the request and route unresolved constraints to building elevator coordinator.
